faq.q: I have never trained before. Can I join?
faq.a: Yes. Most batches start with beginners, and trainers adjust the pace so you learn the basics before anything harder.

faq.q: What age can children start martial arts?
faq.a: Children can usually join from around five years old in kids batches. Please ask us about the right group for your child.

faq.q: What should I bring to class?
faq.a: Wear comfortable clothes, bring a water bottle and a towel. Uniforms and gear for martial arts can be bought at the academy.

faq.q: Is sparring compulsory?
faq.a: No. Sparring comes only after basics and always with protective gear. Students who prefer fitness only can skip it.

faq.q: Do you have batches for women only?
faq.a: Yes. We run women only batches for self defence, zumba and aerobics, with a female trainer where possible.
